saw_lines: Fragrance is picked by smell and by a name people already trust, then rebought for years by the same buyer.
So the sale is won in the first line of the ad, where a buyer either recognizes the scent or keeps scrolling.
Your 25 live ads show no proof number at all. Collect one real figure, such as review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 17 Oct 2026
points: None of your 25 live ads shows a proof number, so a new buyer has no reason to trust the claim. Collect one figure, such as review count or orders shipped, and open the next batch with it on every creative.

4 of your 16 copy ads are creator posts run from the brand page. Buyers read that as a paid push and scroll past, losing the trust the creator built. Whitelist those four posts from the creator account and cut three new variations.
0 of your 16 copy ads mention an offer or discount, so a new buyer sees no reason to act today. Put one first order offer or a bundle in the opening line of three new ads, not the closing line.

Your 16 copy ads open with 12 different stories, and the biggest opens 3 ads. Buyers never remember one pitch, so no story sticks. Pick the two best openings and build the next batch from them, three ads each.

ads_1: Rebuild your two best openers as creative, each with a proof number
soc_1: Brand social strategy for the channels your buyers already use
